body:
I am trying to execute alpasim using a custom USDZ file. My dataset includes camera intrinsics, extrinsics, poses, timestamps, and Gaussian .ply files.

I have successfully generated the following without any None values:

- volume.nurec & volume.usda (via 3dgrut repository)

- rig_trajectories.json

- datasource_summary.json

- Parsed config and data info (based on my custom calibration and tracking results).

The Problem: Despite having all files in place, I keep encountering the following error when running the simulator:

```AssertionError: Missing camera camera_front_wide_120fov@clipgt-05bb8212-63e1-40a8-b4fc-3142c0e94646 in camera calibration```

 I have formatted the camera calibration data in rig_trajectories.json by referencing the original nurec USDZ structure.(also for datasource_summary) The error suggests that Alpasim might be attempting to read the calibration list from a source other than rig_trajectories.json.

Questions:

- Is there a specific metadata field in the USDZ or a separate sidecar file where Alpasim expects to find the camera calibration?

- Does the camera naming convention (e.g., the @clipgt-... suffix) need to match a specific entry in default nurec camera list?

- How can I ensure the simulator properly fetches calibration data from a custom USDZ?

comments.body: This workflow (using 3dgrut) is incompatible with the artifacts necessary for Alpasim. This is a known limitation of the current distribution, although I just heard from a PM: "we will be publishing workflows for people to bring in their own data soon." So, stay tuned.

title: I cannot fetch calibration information during implement custom alpasim environment
